artworks.title: A Classical Temple
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray, brown, and green washes on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a neoclassical architectural structure. The structure features a grand domed building elevated on a series of broad steps, with tall Corinthian columns supporting an entablature that is decorated with relief sculptures. Above the entablature, there is a balustrade adorned with statues standing at intervals. The building's entrance is centrally located at the top of the stairs, marked by a large arched doorway. The drawing emphasizes symmetry and balance, with a focus on geometric shapes and classical architectural elements such as the detailed columns and sculptural decorations.

artworks.title: Capriccio with a Palladian Villa
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a garden path lined with statues and trees. A classical figure statue is close to us on the left. Further down, the path leads to an intricate structure with statues on the roof. The colors are mainly muted earth tones with touches of light blue in the sky.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over red chalk, heightened with white on laid paper, squared for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is a detailed sketch of several figures visible from the waist up. In the center, a seated figure holds a small child, with others gathered closely around. Surrounding the central figures are other people, some kneeling, some standing. Their poses suggest attention and reverence to the central scene. The figures are depicted in various positions, with facial features minimally defined and hair styled differently. The clothing throughout is robes and draped fabric. One figure to the right holds a long staff. The background is a monochromatic, rustic brown wash, with sketchy detailing suggesting an indoor setting, perhaps a stable, with an animal to the left. The ambience is warm and historical with expressive line work capturing a scene.

artworks.title: Ceremony of Consecration
artworks.medium: red chalk over graphite, squared and incised for transfer on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a historical scene with multiple individuals in a columned interior. A central figure is half-kneeling on the ground, surrounded by others standing or sitting around them. The figures are wearing elaborate clothing indicative of a past era. Two individuals stand to the right, with one pointing towards the central figure, and a child is also present. The background features architectural details like tall arches and a decorated wall with circular motifs, suggesting a ceremonial setting. The sketch is outlined in a reddish tone, focusing on form and pose rather than detailed features or color.

artworks.title: Design for a Wall of a Music Room [recto]
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, pen and brown ink, and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a decorative wall panel with a central column adorned with multicolored feathers, greenery, and flowers against a green background. On either side are vertical sections; one features a blue vase under a marble column with intricate designs, and the other displays a green diamond-shaped panel with a sculpted figure. The composition is framed by ornate moldings and decorative bands with gold accents.

artworks.title: Entablature
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural detail. The architectural element features intricate Greco-Roman design elements, including lion heads, floral motifs, and ornamental scrolls. The image primarily shows a cornice or frieze adorned with a series of carved reliefs. Prominent lion heads are positioned on either side of the structure, with stylized acanthus leaves and other classic patterns along the borders. The structure includes columns with decorative elements at their capitals, creating a historical aesthetic akin to ancient architecture. Each element displays elaborate detailing, showcasing a deep appreciation for classical architectural style.

artworks.title: The Flagellation of Christ
artworks.artist: Flemish 17th Century after Hendrik de Clerck
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring figures in an architectural setting. The central figure is bound to a column, with two other figures on each side holding whips or flails. The background shows architectural elements like arches and a dome, creating a grand atmosphere. The drawing uses fine lines and shading for form, texture, and depth. The figures are muscular and dynamic, creating a sense of movement and tension. The architectural details and anatomical accuracy show skilled draftsmanship.

artworks.title: Men Throwing Dice
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals gathered in front of a decorated tent or canopy. One person stands to the left, facing away from the viewer, dressed in elaborate clothing with a long cloak, doublet, and hose. The second person stands to the right, leaning slightly, and wears an ornate robe. Behind them, two individuals are partially obscured. One is turned toward the person on the right, with finely detailed attire and a headpiece with a veil. All individuals are adorned with draped clothing. The tent or canopy is decorated with floral ornaments, ribbons and bows. In the background, there is an intricately carved or embroidered panel.

artworks.title: The Rescue of Deianeira
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural sketch adorned with figures. The drawing depicts a scene featuring an ornate architectural element, upon which a group of figures is depicted. The figures are in dynamic poses, with one figure reaching upward. The architecture is richly ornamented, with classical elements such as swirls and possibly an empty cartouche or shield at its center. The figures are drawn with fluid lines, capturing movement and the human form. Above the figures are rising plumes or clouds adding to the composition of the scene. The drawing is likely meant to convey a story or represent a mythological scene given the poses and attention to composition.

artworks.title: Stage Design
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with brown and gray washes over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image displays a grand architectural scene with classical structures, featuring a series of steps leading towards buildings in the distance. The horizon is obscured by towering structures dominating the skyline. The architecture includes arches, columns, and detailed stonework. The artwork appears to be an ink and wash drawing with precise lines and shading. The color scheme is muted and earthy, primarily soft browns and grays. The composition is balanced by steps in the foreground leading towards distant architecture.

artworks.title: Study for an Altar and a Reredos
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural design featuring elaborate Rococo-style embellishments. The design includes decorative columns with Corinthian capitals, curved pediments, and a central arched niche. Flourishing acanthus leaves and volutes frame the structure. The upper portion is adorned with cherubic figures in motion. The drawing showcases a balance between architectural precision and artistic creativity, embodying the elegance and ornamental complexity typical of the Rococo era.

artworks.title: Tempio della Fortuna Virile with the Tempio di Vesta in the Distance
artworks.medium: gouache on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image displays a street scene with a classic building on the left side, a grassy area in the foreground, and smaller structures in the background. The sun illuminates the building, and the sky is blue with some clouds. Two figures are talking on a dirt path leading to more buildings. The colors are earthy and harmonious.

artworks.title: Two Fountains
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two ornate fountains. The drawing depicts two intricately designed fountains. The fountain on the left features a central column with sculpted birds that act as spouts, allowing water to flow from their beaks. It is composed of multiple tiers with elaborate leafy decorations that resemble cascading water. On the right, the fountain boasts an ornamental urn at the top, surrounded by scrollwork and floral motifs. Both fountains sit on pedestals and are drawn with fine lines and shading that give them a three-dimensional appearance.

artworks.title: Apollo and the Muses
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This drawing depicts mythological figures within clouds. The scene shows ethereal figures with wings and flowing drapery interacting in the clouds. The central figure emits light, surrounded by other figures in admiration or worship. Cherub-like figures are present, some holding objects or instruments, while others gesture around the central figure. Cloud formations below feature dynamic figures in dramatic poses, enhancing the celestial ambiance. The drawing uses monochromatic tones and intricate linework for a classical and harmonious quality.

artworks.title: The Raising of Lazarus
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in different positions interacting with each other. The figures are dressed in robes and are situated in a space with architectural elements. A central figure appears to be gesturing or holding something. The figures are depicted in a sketch-like style with minimal facial and hair details.

artworks.title: The Baths of Caracalla, Rome
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins with classical architectural elements. The horizon is implied by the ruins' elevation. The scene features ornate arches and walls overgrown with vegetation. Delicate ink work with precise brushstrokes creates a balance of dark and light, emphasizing depth and shadow. The color palette is subdued with grays and browns on a light, sepia background. A fragment of carved architectural detail is visible in the foreground.

artworks.title: Diana and Endymion
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white and squared for transfer on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The drawing features two figures with their upper bodies in focus, and parts of their legs visible. One figure, a seated woman, leans towards the other figure, a reclining male resting with his head on a draped cloth. The woman has detailed facial features and styled hair with loose waves. The male has delicate features and his face is in repose. He is partially covered with drapery. The woman wears classical-style drapes with a sense of movement. In the background are ethereal forms or clouds, with a cherubic figure sketched above. A dog is depicted at the bottom right. The scene is rendered in soft, muted tones on brown, textured paper.

artworks.title: A Bearded Man with a Staff
artworks.medium: black chalk and graphite, heightened with white on tan laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch of a person from the waist up, with arms lifted and bent. The individual's head is slightly tilted downwards, focusing below eye level. The facial features include a full beard and short hair. The person wears a loose-fitting shirt with rolled-up sleeves. They hold a long, thin object, possibly a stick or rod, with both hands apart. The background is plain with no distinct features. The sketch is created using pencil or charcoal with shading for depth and form.

artworks.title: Odoratus, L'Ordorat
artworks.medium: engraving in black on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 24 x 32 cm (9 7/16 x 12 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people on a terrace, depicting a historical scene. The central figure stands wearing a decorated dress or coat. Another figure wears period attire with a wide-brimmed hat adorned with feathers, holding a cluster of flowers. Another individual stands nearby. Their facial features are soft and smooth, with neatly arranged hairstyles indicative of historical fashion. The clothing is ornate with patterns and textures fitting the time's style. The terrace has railings, vases, and drapery, adding opulence. A small dog is present, interacting with the people. The background features a garden with trimmed hedges, pathways, and statues under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Valet
artworks.medium: engraving in black on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 29 x 20.4 cm (11 7/16 x 8 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a room. He is facing forward with both arms slightly extended to his sides, each holding a piece of clothing. He has curly hair that falls to his shoulders and a mustache. The man is dressed in opulent historical clothing, including a short, decorative jacket with large cuffs, knee-length trousers with ribbons at the knees, and shoes with large rosettes. Additional clothing is draped over a chair and a trunk. The background features a paneled wall with two leaded glass windows showing a landscape with a building and trees outside.

artworks.title: Ah! il prétend m'empêcher d'aller...
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on newsprint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image depicts three adult figures and an infant. Two women stand on the left, facing a man holding the baby on the right. The woman on the far left raises her arm, the central figure gazes intensely at the man, and the woman on the left has her back partially towards the viewer. The man has short, curled hair and an alarmed expression, and is dressed in a patterned outfit. The women have different hairstyles and wear dark dresses. The backdrop shows simple wall lines, likely representing an interior room.

artworks.title: C'est-y embêtant de brosser ces machines là...
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on newsprint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing indoors. The man on the left has his hands on his hips, looking towards the other man. He has a pointed nose, thinning hair, and a slightly amused expression. He is wearing a jacket, untucked shirt, trousers, and boots. The man on the right is bent forward, holding a tall boot with both hands. He has a pointed nose, curly hair, and a slight smile. He is wearing a waistcoat, collared shirt, rolled-up sleeves, and trousers. There are additional boots and a shoe brush on the floor. The background is a bare wall with a small frame and a wooden floor with a visible crack. The image is a monochromatic drawing.

artworks.title: Oui, ma chère, mon mari a ravalé ma dignité...
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on newsprint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image shows two women standing and embracing each other. The woman on the left has her head slightly turned upward, with distinct facial features emphasized. She wears a dark, long dress with loose fabric covering her head. The woman on the right is turned inward, embracing the first woman with her head on her shoulder. She has neatly styled hair and wears a long dress of a lighter tone. Both women are surrounded by the drapery of their clothes. The background features a curtain with flowing lines, indicating an indoor setting. No jewelry or objects are shown in the scene.

artworks.title: Ah! vous êtes mon mari, ah! vous êtes le maître...
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on newsprint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals - two adults and a child. The woman on the left is pushing the man while pulling a door handle. The man is stumbling backward, and a child is holding onto his leg. The setting includes doors and a sketch of a picture frame on the wall, with a curtain or textured wall as the background.
